title: Every people. Every place.
tagline: From every people group on earth to the ones DOXA prays for, counted from the data.
funnelLabel: From all people groups to DOXA people groups
allNote: each people group, in each country it lives in
sources: People groups: {imb}, data of {date}. DOXA list: pray.doxa.life, {date2}.
ruleAll: Every row of the IMB people-group data: one people group in one country.
ruleUnreached: IMB lostness priority 0 to 2: less than 2% evangelical.

ruleDoxa: Every group on the DOXA prayer list, matched to the IMB data by people and country. Not all are frontier.
